subject: RENAMES clause
notes: kb/Work PB849: `66 data-name-1 RENAMES data-name-2 [{THROUGH|THRU} data-name-3] .` (PDF p394 / folio 364 rendered). The grammar's renamesClause carries the RENAMES / THRU|THROUGH shape (both spellings and the single-item form witnessed); data-name-1 is printed unbracketed and is NOT an entry-name clause, so an omitted name and FILLER are both refused by LevelNumberRules.EntryNameObligation with COBOL1747 — before PB849 both compiled clean and the entry evaporated.
